scope: Alternative rider menu in light and dark themes
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: second approval-only mobile account menu proposal for Rakky Ride. Create a striking but usable high-fidelity board with TWO complete phone-sized app screens side by side, left Light and right Dark, matching content and spacing, no device frames. This is a NEW design direction: elegant open layout with confident typography, plain navigation rows, a slim divider between sections and a small playful 3D car invitation at bottom. No dashboard grid, no shortcut tiles, no boxed profile card, no individually boxed menu rows, no menu section headings. Image 1 is the canonical Rakky Ride shield logo reference; use this actual shield small beside the Rakky Ride wordmark in header, do NOT invent a letter R logo. Image 2 is only the reference for the clean stylized matte green 3D car used small in the bottom banner. Portrait screen proportions 390x844. Header small Rakky Ride branding left and understated circular close X at right. Below, an OPEN profile area directly on the screen background, avatar initials AR in a soft green 56px circle, name 'Alex Rider' in confident 24px text, small Rider role label, understated 'View profile' text link with arrow. Then 7 evenly spaced clean full-width navigation rows, each has a refined consistent thin outline icon, readable medium-weight 16px label, quiet chevron at far right. Rows in order 'Ride history', 'Payment', 'Services', then a small vertical breathing gap and fine divider, then 'Notifications', 'Safety', 'Help & support', 'Settings'. Each exact label appears ONCE. Row height about 52px, no subtitles. Bottom safe-area inset contains a LOW compact mint-tinted rounded banner, around 82px high: left title 'Drive with Rakky' and green link 'Apply to drive →'; right a SMALL clean clay 3D green car about 78px wide, entire car visible, illustration only within this banner. Nothing overlaps the navigation or fills the screen. Light theme WHITE background with silver hairline separators, charcoal #141A14 type, forest #176B17 accents and pale mint #EAF5E5 banner. Dark theme NEUTRAL charcoal #141A14 background, pale silver text, muted charcoal surfaces, leaf #83E46F accents with charcoal labels where filled. Dark mode should not be an olive green page. Crisp native mobile spacing, restrained premium urban mobility identity, readable 13px supporting text. Omit ratings, phone numbers, balances, logout, bottom tab bars, extra buttons, large illustrations, heavy shadows and decorative gradients. All identity details fictional. Put small labels Light and Dark OUTSIDE the screens on the board.
